<!-- stephanos:vr2707-20261105-1953-cf7-archive-1item-truncation-recovery-v1 -->
Follow-up to same original #2707/#1591 read-only historical archive. First bounded 4-record [DONE #6667735974](https://github.com/Cheekyfellastef/stephan-os/issues/3258#issuecomment-6667735974) authentic outcome STARFIELD_VR_TELEMETRY_ARCHIVE_READY, exact expected process head, proofHash; but its public GitHub projection was `githubProjectionTruncated=true` and omitted session summary. This SECOND scoped page reduces telemetryLimit to 1 to try obtaining publishable session-level proof. It does not mutate game, governor, config, source, services, keys, approvals or source custody, and it is not physical Quest E2E acceptance. No duplicate of the earlier requestId.
